data.name: Qaasimah
data.gender_notes: Qaasimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qaasimah means 'one who distributes or shares'. In Islamic tradition, it is associated with generosity and kindness, as Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) son was named Qaasim, symbolizing his equal distribution of love and kindness to all. The name Qaasimah carries the meaning “Distributor, Sharer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Qaasimah usually hope their child will grow to embody distributor, sharer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To share and distribute love, kindness and resources, reflecting the teachings of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)
data.etymology: Qaasimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Distributor, Sharer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qaasimah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: قاسمہ
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث عربي يرمز بالحد والقوة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مؤنث عربي مشتق من الفعل 'قسم' بمعنى قسمة و تقسيم، ويدل على صفات الفصل، و الجلاء، و القدرة على تقسيم و فصل الأمور بوضوح و دقة. و من المعروف أن 'قاسم' في اللغة العربية قد يرمز إلى الحكمة و الإحاطة، و قد يُستخدم في بعض المصادر الإسلامية لوصف الملائكة، و قد يعني أيضاً القوة و الاستقلال.

in_urdu.name: قاسمہ
in_urdu.meaning: قسم یا تقسیم کے معنی رکھتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: قاسمہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو الفعل 'قسم' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا معنی 'قسم' یا 'تقسیم' ہے۔ یہ ایک مسلم نام ہے جسے لڑکیوں کے لیے دیا جاتا ہے۔ اس کا معنی ہے 'پہلے سے فیصلہ کرنا' یا 'عقیدہ کا اعلان کرنا'۔

in_hindi.name: क़ासीमह
in_hindi.meaning: भाग या विभाजन का अर्थ है
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़ासीमह एक अरबी नाम है जो 'क़سم' कर्म से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ 'भाग' या 'विभाजन' है। यह एक मुस्लिम नाम है जो लड़कियों के लिए दिया जाता है। इसका अर्थ है 'पहले से फैसला करना' या 'पुनर्निर्माण करना'.

in_english.name: Qaasimah
in_english.long_meaning: Qaasimah is an Arabic name meaning 'divider' or 'partitioner,' derived from the root word 'qasm,' which signifies separation, division, or allocation. It embodies qualities of discernment, clarity, and the ability to distinguish and organize things effectively. In Islamic tradition, 'qasm' can also allude to wisdom, comprehension, and divine decree. While not directly mentioned in the Quran, the name carries spiritual connotations of justice, order, and the ability to bring clarity to complex situations.

data.cultural_impact: The name Qaasimah holds cultural significance as it is believed to be derived from the Arabic root "qasama," which means "to share" or "to divide equally." It signifies a generous and kind-hearted individual, one who distributes resources, time, or talents evenly among people, promoting social harmony and communal bonding.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Qaasimah holds great spiritual significance in Islamic culture, as it is a reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) son, Ali ibn Abu Talib's (RA) beloved child named Qaasim (born to Fatimah bint Muhammad (RAA) and Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA)). Qaasim represents the Prophet's teachings on kindness, love, and selflessness. The name Qaasimah, given to a girl, thus carries the message of emulating the generous and loving spirit of Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) family and spreading kindness to those around us.
